environment: Dart 3.12.2 AOT, macOS arm64, 10 logical CPUs
method: Three viewports; base/candidate/candidate/base. Pipeline: 30 initialization frames before tree enumeration, 30 warmup, 300 frames per mode, counters disabled. Retained: 30 warmup, 200 frames per mode, debug counters enabled. Own compilation and tests stopped during timings; shared host not isolated.
limits: Pipeline clean forces rendering; production idle skips it. Leaf mutates a visible RenderText directly, not widget state or user input. Total includes buffer preparation, build/layout/paint, exact diff, scroll classification, commit and post-frame callbacks; excludes encoding, transport and terminal display. Medians and p95 are per-run distributions, not device or energy evidence.
